svg.title: Two numbers behind “Ozempic face”
svg.desc: Vanderbilt study, 20 patients with CT or MRI scans before and after a GLP-1 prescription, average weight loss 11.0 kg: median midface volume fell 9 percent in total, 11 percent in the superficial fat and 7 percent in the deep fat. A 2023 meeting abstract on 5 Ozempic patients who lost 21.1 percent of body weight over 9.4 months reported a 41.8 percent drop in temple fat and 69.9 percent in cheek fat.
